zh: 最终那段同速连续队伍，一定由某种速度的若干次“相邻出现”组成；它们之间夹着的其他速度选手必须全部删掉。
设某种速度的出现位置为 p，保留第 l 到第 r 次出现需要删除 p[r]−p[l]−(r−l) 人；这个量随 r 增大不减、随 l 增大不增，适合双指针。
按速度分组记录下标（哈希表，或按 (速度, 下标) 排序）；每组用双指针：右端前进，当 p[r]−p[l]−(r−l)>k 时左端前进；用 r−l+1 更新答案。
en: The final run of equal speeds always consists of consecutive occurrences of one speed; every racer with another speed between them must be deleted.
If p holds the positions of one speed, keeping its l-th through r-th occurrences requires deleting p[r] - p[l] - (r - l) racers; this grows with r and shrinks with l, which suits two pointers.

Group indices by speed (a hash map, or sort (speed, index) pairs); in each group move the right pointer forward and advance the left pointer while p[r] - p[l] - (r - l) > k; update the answer with r - l + 1.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Store the positions of each speed. Slide a window over each group's positions; the number of deletions needed inside it is positions[r]-positions[l]-(r-l), kept at most k.

## Proof of correctness

To keep the l-th through r-th occurrences of a speed, every racer with another speed between the two ends must be deleted, which costs exactly the total span minus the number of same-speed racers; deleting them makes those racers contiguous. An optimal run never needs to delete same-speed racers inside it, so only consecutive occurrences within each group need to be considered, and the two pointers exhaust the longest valid windows.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
